physical_storage_policy.purpose_metadata_storage: sidecar mapping keyed by document_id + content_hash
physical_storage_policy.embedding_policy: one embedding per unique content_hash; purpose filters are metadata filters

tutor_policy.approved_data: candidate only until license is cleared
tutor_policy.chapter_filter: concept_id/concept_code/stage_id when canonical curriculum is available

question_generation_policy.approved_data: candidate only until mapping and license are approved

source_review_status.approved: source passed existing ingestion/index eligibility; not expert or license approval
source_review_status.needs_review: source has unresolved extraction/review flags; do not index or generate from it

mapping_review_status.approved: human reviewer confirms relevance to the named chapter/concept and evidence span
mapping_review_status.needs_review: candidate is plausible but evidence, scope, or category is unresolved
mapping_review_status.irrelevant: not relevant to the named chapter/concept; retain in canonical source but exclude from that purpose mapping

license_status.approved: permission/attribution terms verified for the intended use
license_status.pending_review: license value exists but permission/attribution is not cleared
